k1892: A 620 m² plot at Spitallë on a made-up road, a hundred metres from the main route, suited to a warehouse or workshop.
k1893:
A plot at Spitallë near University Road, a hundred metres back from the main route.

The total area is 620 m², with 500 m² recorded on the certificate. The land fronts a made-up road and is entered directly from it.

That access is what makes the plot useful: a warehouse or a workshop needs a surface a lorry can reach without churning up a track, and here it is already there.

The area is developing and the mortgage paperwork is in order. The seller is open to discussing the price.
k1894: Private house on a 390 m² plot, Lagjja e Re, Durrës
k1895: An 81 m² house at Lagjja e Re standing on a generous 390 m² plot, in a quiet residential part of Durrës.
k1896:
A private house at Lagjja e Re, in a settled and quiet part of Durrës.

The building covers 81 m², and it stands on a plot of 390 m² — nearly five times its own footprint. That is what this purchase is really about: the yard around it is generous by the standards of a city plot, and it leaves room to extend, to build, or simply to keep the space.

The house as it stands can be adapted to what a buyer needs rather than accepted as found.

The area is residential and quiet, with good access to the main services of the city.
k1897: Spacious 1+1 apartment with a sea view, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1898: An 85 m² one-bedroom flat at Shkëmbi i Kavajës with a sea view, in a building with a lift.
k1899:
A 1+1 apartment at Shkëmbi i Kavajës with the sea in view.

The net area is 85 m², which is unusually large for this layout — most one-bedroom flats on this coast sit closer to fifty. The extra space shows in the rooms rather than in the hallway.

The building has a lift, and the position is among the better ones on this stretch: close enough to the water for the view to be the point, and inside an area that stays busy through the season.

The price here is quoted per square metre rather than as a total, so the final sum follows the exact area agreed.
k1900: Studio on the second floor, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1901: A 34 m² studio on the second floor at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, in a building with a lift, close to the sea.
k1902:
A studio at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, on the second floor of a building with a lift.

The total area is 34 m², with 29.2 m² recorded on the certificate, arranged as a single functional space.

The location is the argument: this is one of the more sought-after parts of the Durrës coast, and the sea is close enough to walk to without thinking about it.

A flat this size works as a first purchase, a summer base, or something let either by the week in season or on a longer tenancy through the year.
k1903: Spacious 2+1 apartment on the second floor, Ish-Rajoni
k1904: A 78 m² two-bedroom flat on the second floor in Ish-Rajoni, an established and easily reached part of Durrës.
k1905:
A 2+1 apartment in Ish-Rajoni, on the second floor of an established building.

The net area is 78 m²: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. The rooms are generous for the layout and the plan is workable rather than clever.

The quarter is properly lived in — not a new development but a settled part of Durrës, with the everyday services already where people need them.

The second floor keeps the stairs short. It suits a family, and the position holds its value as an investment.
k1906: 437 m² roadside plot at Nishtulla, Durrës
k1907: A 437 m² plot at Nishtulla with direct access from the main road, suited to a workshop or warehouse.
k1908:
A plot of 437 m² at Nishtulla, fronting the main road.

The land is entered straight from the road, with no track or neighbouring yard in between — which is the condition that decides whether a site of this size is usable for anything commercial.

The shape and position suit a workshop, a warehouse or a small industrial unit rather than a house: this is a working part of Durrës and the traffic is the point of it.

Nothing is built on the plot, so what goes up is a matter for the buyer and the planning rules.
k1909: New ground-floor 1+1 with terrace and parking, Golem
k1910: A new 54 m² one-bedroom flat at ground level in Golem, 150 m from the sea, with a terrace, full furnishing and a private parking space.
k1911:
A new 1+1 apartment at Golem, a hundred and fifty metres from the sea, on the ground floor.

The flat covers 54 m²: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, with a generous terrace attached.

It is furnished and equipped with all the white goods, and a private parking space belongs to it. Nothing needs buying or fixing before it can be lived in or let — which for a flat this close to the beach means it can earn from the first season.

Being at ground level makes the terrace part of daily life rather than a balcony to look at, and it means carrying luggage in without stairs.
k1912: Modern studio in the centre of Plazh, 150 m from the sea
k1913: A 37 m² studio on the fourth floor in the middle of Plazh, furnished and equipped, with a balcony and a parking space.
k1914:
A modern studio in the middle of Plazh, a hundred and fifty metres from the sea — two or three minutes on foot.

The flat measures 37 m² and sits on the fourth floor of a building with a lift. It is furnished and equipped with all the white goods, and the balcony comes with a table and chairs already on it.

The surroundings do the rest: cafés, bars, restaurants and supermarkets are fifty to a hundred metres away, and the bus stop is close by. For a flat meant to be let to visitors, that combination is worth more than extra floor area.

A parking space belongs to it. Nothing needs doing before it can be used.
k1915: Front-line 1+1 apartment with a panoramic sea view, Plazh
k1916: A 65 m² one-bedroom flat on the front line at Plazh with an open sea view, on the fifth floor of a building without a lift.
k1917:
A 1+1 apartment on the front line at Plazh, with the sea directly in front of it.

The total area is 65 m², with 60 m² recorded on the certificate: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the fifth floor.

The view is what is being bought — an open panorama across the water, with nothing built in between. On this coast the front line keeps getting scarcer, and the flats that hold it hold their value with it.

The building has no lift. At the fifth floor that is the plain trade-off, and it is reflected in the price against comparable flats with one.
k1918: 2+1 apartment with two balconies near Hotel Koral, Plazh
k1919: A 100 m² flat laid out as a 2+1 with two balconies on the fifth floor at Plazh; the lift starts from the first floor, not the ground.
k1920:
A roomy apartment at Plazh near Hotel Koral, laid out as a 2+1 with two balconies.

The total area is 100 m² with 92 m² net, which leaves the rooms genuinely large rather than nominally so. It sits on the fifth floor.

One detail deserves stating rather than discovering on the viewing: the building has a lift, but it starts from the first floor, so there is a flight of stairs from the entrance before it. Worth knowing if that matters.

The two balconies are on the credit side, giving cross ventilation through the summer. The area is easy to get around from, with the main services close by.
k1921: 1+1 apartment on the second floor, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1922: A 69 m² one-bedroom flat on the second floor at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, in a building with a lift; the price is open to discussion.
k1923:
A 1+1 apartment at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, on the second floor of a building with a lift.

The total area is 69 m² with 59 m² net — comfortably more than most flats of this layout on the coast, and the difference shows in the rooms.

The second floor is an easy one to live with: short stairs when the lift is out, and still far enough up to stay clear of the street.

Shkëmbi i Kavajës is among the more sought-after parts of the Durrës coastline, close to the sea and busy through the season. The seller will discuss the price.
k1924: 2+1 apartment with two bathrooms and a 34 m² veranda, Lagjja 18
k1925: A two-bedroom flat of 70 m² with two bathrooms and a 34 m² veranda, on the second floor in Lagjja 18.
k1926:
A 2+1 apartment in Lagjja 18, on the second floor of a building with a lift.

The flat itself is 70 m² — two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and two bathrooms — and a veranda of 34 m² comes with it, bringing the whole to 104 m².

Two things are unusual here. Two bathrooms in a two-bedroom flat is rare in this market and tells whenever more than two people live in it. And a veranda of that size is not a balcony: it is an outdoor room, and what it becomes is up to whoever takes it.

The quarter is settled and residential, with the main services within reach.
k1927: 1+1 apartment convertible to 2+1, 100 m from the sea, Plazh
k1928: An 80 m² one-bedroom flat a hundred metres from the sea, on the fifth floor with a lift, with room to add a second bedroom.
k1929:
A 1+1 apartment at Plazh near the Bajram Curri school, a hundred metres from the sea.

The total area is 80 m² with 73 m² net: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the fifth floor of a building with a lift.

The floor area leaves room for a second bedroom, and converting it to a 2+1 is the obvious move for a buyer who needs one — eighty square metres is generous for a single bedroom and tight for nothing.

Being a hundred metres back from the water is the useful distance: the beach is a walk, not an outing, and the noise stays on the front.
k1930: 1+1 apartment with a sea view, Plazh Iliria
k1931: A 60 m² one-bedroom flat on the fourth floor at Plazh Iliria, with a sea view and a lift; not the top floor.
k1932:
A 1+1 apartment at Plazh Iliria, a few metres from the sea and with a view of it.

The total area is 60 m², with 52.2 m² on the certificate: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom. The flat is on the fourth floor of a building with a lift — and not the top one, which spares it the roof in August.

The combination of a sea view and a flat this close to the water is what sets the asking price here, and it is also what keeps such flats occupied through the season.

The seller is open to discussing the price.
k1933: 2+1 apartment with two bathrooms, Rrota e Kuqe, Plazh
k1934: A 100 m² two-bedroom flat with two bathrooms on the fourth floor at Rrota e Kuqe, in a building with a lift.
k1935:
A 2+1 apartment at Rrota e Kuqe, in the Plazh area of Durrës.

The flat measures 100 m² gross and 90 m² net: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and two bathrooms, on the fourth floor of a building with a lift.

Two bathrooms is the detail that separates this from most flats of the same size on this coast. With two bedrooms in use it stops being a luxury and starts being the thing that makes a morning work.

The area is among the more popular parts of the Durrës beachfront, and a flat of this size here suits a family living in it as readily as an owner letting it.
k1936: 1+1 apartment on the sixth floor, Plazh Hekurudha
k1937: A 70 m² one-bedroom flat on the sixth floor at Plazh Hekurudha, with a lift and the paperwork in order.
k1938:
A 1+1 apartment in the Hekurudha part of Plazh.

The total area is 70.3 m² with 64.4 m² on the certificate: a living room with the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom, on the sixth floor of a building with a lift.

Seventy square metres is a comfortable margin for this layout — the rooms are proper rooms rather than the minimum the notation allows.

The paperwork is in order, which shortens the part of a purchase that usually drags. The position suits living here, keeping it for the summer, or letting it by the season.
k1939: Studio with its own private entrance, Plazh Hekurudha
k1940: A 47 m² studio at Plazh Hekurudha with a dedicated entrance of its own, on the first residential floor.
